== wrap internal format with d code ==

This is the source text of a a backend for the language machine metalanguage compiler. This backend compiles the internal representation produced by the forntend to an internal format that can be directly loaded by the language machine. 

The language machine is (C) Copyright 2005 Peri Hankey and is published under the Gnu General Program License. It comes with absolutely no warranty. 

== wrap front end analysis with backend context ==
  .lmn2x(B)
  - var Is  = 0; 
    var Ir  = 0; 
    var If  = 0;
    var Sy  = [];
    Sy.func = [];
    
    prelude generate units  postlude generate
      <- outer ;

== prelude ==   
    - <- prelude   
      say 
      "import lm.lmd;\n" 
      "import lm.licenseGnuGPLv2;\n\n" 
      output
      lmn;

== postlude ==
    - var I = 0; <- postlude 
      compile  
            
      "extern (C) mode lmdInit(inout stream s){\n"    
         "needft(s, " If ");\n"
         {for(I = 0; I < If; I++) { "makeft(s, "I ", &fun"I");\n" }}   
         {for(I = 0; I < Ir; I++) { "define(s, rul" I ");\n" }}
        "return null;\n"
        "}\n"
        
      code
      lmn
      ;
    
== rules that generate output ==
  .lmn2x(1010R)
    eof                            <- generate eof;
    - lmn                          <- generate ;
    - uri                          <- lmn    - ;
    
    say output                     <- lmn    - ;
    - out                          <- output - ;
 
    compile code                   <- lmn    - ;
    - out                          <- code   - ;
    
== objects that are internal to this this backend ==
    w                              <- lmn - 'w'             sp ;
    g                              <- lmn - 'g'             sp ;
    gx                             <- lmn - 'G'             sp ;
    vx                             <- lmn - 'V'             sp ;
    sx :X                          <- lmn - '(' sp   X  ')' sp gx;
    zzz  lineNo :A <- lmn - say "ERROR (feature not implemented) near line " A "\n" output ;

== the interface with the frontend ==
    eoc                            <- lmn - ;
    eox                            <- lmn - '.' sp ; 
    lu :X                          <- lmn - X ; 

    top  :X                             <- lmn - lm :X 'T' nl;
    rdef      :A :G :P :N :I :L :J :R   <- lmn - 
        say "static char[] rul"$(Ir++)" = \"" output m :G P  n:N lm :{ I L } lm :{ J R } "r" say " \";" output nl ;
         
    rval rdef :A :G :P :N :I :L :J :R   <- lmn -    G P nm:N sx :{ I L } sx :{ J R } op:'rule' ;

== flattening of external function calls ==   
    fd :fname :F :B  var N = 0;                     <- lmn - fcode fN B eoc :F :B ;
    
    fN var N = 0; arglist                           <- numargs :N;
    arg :X   ++N;                                   <- arglist - ;
    eoc                                             <- arglist   ;
    
    fcode numargs :N :F :B  var I = 0; var V = 0;     <- lmn - 
      say {
        if(!Sy.func[F]) { 
          Sy.func[F] = [];
          "extern (C) element " F "(inout stream, ...)" eoc 
          }
        if(Sy.func[F][N] == null) {
          Sy.func[F][N] = I = If++; 
          "extern (C) element fun" I "(inout stream s){\n" ga :{$(V++)} B  eoc "return " F "(s" ca :{$(--V)} B eoc ");\n}\n" 
          }      
      }      
      output;
      
    sy :X                          <- fname :X ;
    va :X                          <- fname :X ;
   
    ga :I arg :X                   <- output - "element a" I "= pop(s);\n" ga :I ;
    ga :I eoc                      <- output - ;
    
    ca :I arg :X                   <- output - ", a" I ca :I ;
    ca :I eoc                      <- output - ;
    
    arg :X                         <- argdecl ;
    da argdecl                     <- output - ", element" da;
    da ")"                         <- output - ")";
    eoc                            <- output - ";\n";

== other kinds of flattening are not needed ==
    sd :I :B                       <- lmn - ;
    ad :I :B                       <- lmn - ;

== injected and nested sequences ==
    ij :I :X  
                     <- lmn - sx:X op:'inj' ; 
    lm :X                          <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp ;
    
    bx :X                          <- lmn - X ;
    
== symbols and similar primitive objects ==
    void                           <- lmn - 'z'       sp ;
    c  :X                          <- lmn - 'c:' X    sp ; 
    d  :X                          <- lmn - 'm:' X    sp ; 
    m  :X                          <- lmn - 'm:' X    sp ; 
    n  :X                          <- lmn - 'n:' X    sp ;  
    v  :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X    sp ; 
    x  :X                          <- lmn - 'l:['X']' sp ;  
   
== priority speficifiers (only in rule headers) == 
    lp :X                          <- lmn - 'L:' X    sp ;  
    rp :X                          <- lmn - 'R:' X    sp ;  
    bp :X                          <- lmn - 'B:' X    sp ; 
    mp :X                          <- lmn - 'M:' X    sp ; 
    
== various kinds of operand ==
   ac :I :X                       <- lmn -        X  ; 
    sv :I :X                       <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp gx; 
    sq :I :X                       <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp gx; 
    dq :X                          <- lmn - 'd:' X       sp gx; 
    ty :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;  
    vr :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;
    va :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp vx;  
    sy :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;  
    nm :X                          <- lmn - 'n:' X       sp gx; 

== various special operations ==
    ax :X                          <- lmn - X         'B' sp ; 
    al :X                          <- lmn - X         'A' sp ; 
    ex :X                          <- lmn - X         'E' sp ; 
    ea :X                          <- lmn - X         'e' sp ; 
    t                              <- lmn -           't' sp ; 
    pp :X                          <- lmn - X         'p' sp ; 
    pq :I :B                       <- lmn - lm  :B    'p' sp ;  
    pb :X                          <- lmn - X         'b' sp ; 
    ap :X                          <- lmn - X     op:'apply' ; 
    op :X                          <- lmn - 'f:' X        sp ; 
    uf :X                          <- lmn - 'F:' X        sp ; 
    ou :X                          <- lmn - X op:"append" sp ; 
    truth :V                       <- lmn - op :V ;
    
== repeat and option constructs ==
    r1     :I :B                   <- lmn -   m:"option"  B  ;
    rz     :I :B                   <- lmn -   m:"repeat"  B  ;
    rn :X  :I :B                   <- lmn - X m:"repeatN" B  ;
    
== array subscripts and fields ==
    idx  :A :B                     <- lmn - A    B       op:'idx' ;
    dot  :A :B                     <- lmn - A    d :B gx op:'idt' ;

== array literals ==
   arrayinit  :A                  <- lmn - args :A op:'array' ; 
    cellN      :X                  <- lmn - X ; 
    cellV      :N  :X              <- lmn - N X op:'cell' ; 

== initialisation of variables ==   
    inits    :A                    <- lmn - A  eox ; 
    initz    :A                    <- lmn - sy :A sy:"null" w ; 
    initv    :A :B                 <- lmn - sy :A B         w ; 

== conditionals ==   
    xif      :E :A :B              <- lmn - E sx:A B op:'if' ; 
    xelsif   :E :B :C              <- lmn - sx :{ iff :B :C :A }; 
    xelse    :B                    <- lmn - sx :B  ; 
    xelsez                         <- lmn - sx :{} ;
  
== loop constructs ==
    xnext    :E                    <- lmn - E ;
    xtest    :E                    <- lmn - E op:test ;
    xdo      :E :B                 <- lmn - sx :{ B  E }    op:'loop';  
    xwhile   :E :B                 <- lmn - sx :{ E  B }    op:'loop'; 
    xfor     :I :E :N :B           <- lmn - I sx :{ E B N } op:'loop'; 
    
    xcont0                         <- lmn - op :"continue";     
    xbreak0                        <- lmn - op :"break" ;

== function calls are mapped to external calls ==
    arg   :A                       <- lmn - A ; 
    fcall numargs :N :F :A         <- lmn - A uf :(Sy.func[F][N]);
    fn    :fname :F :A             <- lmn - fcall fN A eoc :F :A ; 

    args  :A                       <- lmn - op:'args' A ; 

== expressions transmitted in categorised prefix form ==
    br    :A                       <- lmn - A ; 
    ","   :A :B                    <- lmn - A eox B ;
    "?"   :A :B :C                 <- lmn - A sx :{ B } sx:{ C } op:'sel' ; 
    fl :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A sx :{ B } op:F  ;  
    fA :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fa :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fb :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fc :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fe :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fq :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fx :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fs :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    
    ur   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    ux   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    ub   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    aa   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ;  
    
    "-"                            <- unary :"neg" ;
    "~"                            <- unary :"inv" ;
    "!"                            <- unary :"not" ;
    
    pre  :preop  :F :A             <- lmn - A  F;  
    post :postop :F :A             <- lmn - A  F; 

    "--"                          <- postop  :{ op:'postdec' }; 
    "++"                          <- postop  :{ op:'postinc' }; 

    "--"                          <- preop   :{ op:'predec' }; 
    "++"                          <- preop   :{ op:'preinc' };
